name: Online Receding Horizon Replanning
definition: An online navigation loop that combines trajectory planning and pose estimation. It replans the trajectory at each step using the updated state belief from the pose filter, allowing the robot to respond to disturbances and dynamic changes.
summary: Online Receding Horizon Replanning is a vision-based robot navigation pipeline that dynamically replans trajectories within a Neural Radiance Field to handle disturbances and change obstacle paths.
